singleton.instruction: Get both instances, then toggle the promotion. Do both readers change together?

feedback.cart: The cart has its settings. Get the background reference and compare the object IDs.
feedback.job: Both entry points use the same object ID, not two separate settings objects.
feedback.toggle: Compare the two readers: the shared setting changes, rather than two separate page values.

factory-method.instruction: Choose email or SMS and send. Watch the middle product-creation step.

feedback.email: Email is selected. Preparation and sending keep the same workflow.
feedback.sms: SMS is selected. The surrounding notification workflow is reused.
feedback.send: Sent. The creator supplies a different sender within the same business workflow.

abstract-factory.instruction: Select the dark factory. Watch the button and checkbox change as one family.

feedback.light: Both controls belong to the light product family.
feedback.dark: One selection replaces both kinds of controls, not two independent settings.

builder.instruction: Enable the header and build. Then disable it. Compare the draft with the built task.

feedback.format: The format changes only the draft. An already-built task keeps its format until you build again.
feedback.header: Only the draft changes. An already-built task stays unchanged.
feedback.compress: Compression changes the draft. Build delivers a new task.
feedback.build: The right side now holds an independent task. Change the draft to compare them.

prototype.instruction: Try a shallow copy and add a tag. Reset, clone, and add a tag again. Does the template change?

feedback.shallow: The copy shares the template's tag list. Add a tag to the copy.
feedback.clone: This copy has its own tag list. Edit it and check that the template stays unchanged.
feedback.edit: Compare the two tag lists: the shallow copy affects the template; an independent clone does not.
feedback.reset: The template is restored. Try the other copying method.

adapter.instruction: Drag the amount. Watch business yuan become SDK cents.

feedback.amount: The SDK receives 100 times the business amount. The adapter handles the unit conversion.

bridge.instruction: Choose urgent, then switch email and SMS. Can form and channel vary independently?

feedback.normal: The form is normal; the selected channel is unchanged.
feedback.urgent: The urgent marker is added without changing the channel.
feedback.email: Only the channel changes to email.
feedback.sms: Only the channel changes to SMS; the form remains independently selectable.

composite.instruction: Add an item, then wrap the bundle. Does another level incorrectly increase the total?

feedback.add: The total increases by 10. Items return their prices; the bundle sums them.
feedback.nest: Wrapping adds a level, not a price. Items and bundles support the same total operation.
feedback.reset: The tree is restored to two items, 10 and 20, totaling 30.

decorator.instruction: Add milk, then sugar, then remove the outer layer. Compare the layers and the price.

feedback.milk: A milk wrapper adds 2 while keeping its inner drink intact.
feedback.sugar: A sugar wrapper adds 1 without introducing a new coffee subclass.
feedback.remove: Only the most recently added wrapper is removed.
feedback.reset: All wrappers are removed. The base coffee costs 5.

facade.instruction: Start the system. Watch the database, cache, and logging complete in order.

feedback.start: The subsystems run in order. The facade coordinates them for the caller.
feedback.reset: The startup sequence is cleared. Run it again to watch the order.

flyweight.instruction: Plant two oaks, then a pine. Compare tree count with shared type count.

feedback.oak: Oak selected. Planted oaks share type data but keep individual positions.
feedback.pine: Pine selected. The first planted pine adds one shared type.
feedback.plant: Compare counts and type IDs: the type is shared; each position remains separate.
feedback.reset: The map and type pool are cleared.

proxy.instruction: Create a proxy, then display twice. Watch when the real load count changes from 0 to 1.

feedback.create: The proxy exists, but the image is not loaded yet. Display it next.
feedback.display: The first display loads the image; subsequent displays reuse it. Loads remain at 1.
feedback.reset: The proxy and image are cleared; loads return to 0.

chain-of-responsibility.instruction: Submit an 800 refund, then try 6000. Watch forwarding, handling, and the unhandled case.

feedback.amount: Amount changed, not submitted. Submit to see the handling path.
feedback.submit: Follow the chain left to right: forward if over the limit, handle at the first eligible person, otherwise unhandled.

command.instruction: Insert to turn A into AB, then undo. Watch the text and undo history change together.

feedback.text: This is pending input. Execute the insertion to change the editor.
feedback.execute: The text is appended and the operation enters history. You can undo it now.
feedback.undo: The last command is undone. The editor returns to its previous text.

interpreter.instruction: Set age above 18, then uncheck membership. Compare each condition with the combined result.

feedback.age: Age is evaluated immediately. Both conditions must be true for the combined result.
feedback.member: Membership is evaluated separately. The combined result is false if either condition is false.

iterator.instruction: Read the next items, then switch to reverse. The collection stays in place while reading order changes.

feedback.forward: Reading starts at A; the collection remains A, B, C.
feedback.reverse: Reading starts at C without reversing the original collection.
feedback.next: The highlighted song is the item just read. The iterator tracks the position.
feedback.reset: The reading position is reset; the songs are unchanged.

mediator.instruction: Edit the search, then clear it. Watch the mediator synchronize the results.

feedback.query: The mediator receives the search event and updates results; the input does not call the result component.
feedback.clear: The clear button notifies the mediator, which clears both input and results.

memento.instruction: Save A, edit the text to ABC, then restore the snapshot.

feedback.text: Current text changes, but saved snapshots retain their original content.
feedback.save: The snapshot stores this text and cursor. Edit again, then restore it to compare.
feedback.restore: Text and cursor return to the saved moment. State is restored rather than operations replayed.

observer.instruction: Publish once, unsubscribe the display, then publish again. Compare the two notification histories.

feedback.display: Subscription changes affect future notifications, not existing history.
feedback.email: Email subscription is independent. The publisher notifies current subscribers only.
feedback.publish: Stock increased. Only currently subscribed receivers get this new notification.
feedback.reset: Notification history is cleared; stock and subscriptions stay unchanged.

state.instruction: Click three times: start, pause, resume. The same action behaves according to the current state.

feedback.click: The highlighted box is the current state. The history shows how the same action causes different transitions.
feedback.stop: The player is stopped. Clicking again starts playback.

template-method.instruction: Import CSV, then JSON. Which of the three steps changes?

feedback.csv: CSV uses comma splitting in the transform step; reading and saving stay the same.
feedback.json: JSON replaces the transform step with JSON parsing.
feedback.run: Both formats produce A and B. The fixed workflow reuses reading and saving.

visitor.instruction: Compute sizes, then export names. The same file structure supports two different operations.

feedback.size: Size calculation selected. Visit to compute the total without changing the files.
feedback.names: Name export selected. No export logic needs to be added to each file node.
feedback.visit: The selected visitor performs the operation. Switch visitors to change the result, not the structure.
